full_prompt_en: A square mixed-media flower painting fills the frame with oversized open blossoms in magenta, hot pink, violet, turquoise, yellow, cream, and orange against a bright white ground. The selected artwork is a close view rather than a room scene: stems rise from the lower edge, while petals overlap from side to side and are cropped at the top and right borders. At the lower left, a deep purple and pink bloom opens around a dark center marked with tiny yellow and green accents. Above it, a larger pink flower leans inward, its petals outlined by loose dark marks. Near the center, a turquoise blossom sits partly behind a warm orange-and-fuchsia flower, whose black seed-like center creates a sharp focal point. On the right, a broad violet bloom opens toward the viewer below a pale cream-yellow flower; smaller orange and pink blooms fill the lower right. Thin dark green stems and irregular leaves thread between the bright heads, giving a loose vertical structure to the otherwise crowded cluster. The white background remains visible only in broken pockets, spattered with circular dots, paint drips, charcoal scratches, and translucent pale blue patches. Colors overlap in transparent and opaque layers; petals show quick pencil or ink contours, uneven washes, and small dry-brush marks rather than smooth gradients. Lighting is bright and diffuse, so the paper itself supplies the whitest value and dark centers supply local depth. No readable text appears. The overall composition is exuberant and almost all-over, balancing strong color clashes with white intervals, dark linear stems, and splashed handmade texture.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形混合媒介花卉画以洋红、亮粉、紫、青绿、黄、奶油与橙色的大型开放花朵填满画面，底色明亮洁白。选定作品是近景而非室内场景：花茎从下缘升起，花瓣横向彼此重叠，并在上缘与右边缘被裁切。左下方，一朵深紫和粉红的花围绕深色花心展开，花心上有细小的黄绿重音。它上方，一朵更大的粉花向内倾斜，花瓣由松散深线勾出。中央附近，一朵青绿色花部分藏在暖橙与紫红的花后，后者黑色籽状花心形成鲜明焦点。右侧，一朵宽大的紫罗兰色花在浅奶油黄花下朝向观者开放；较小的橙花与粉花填满右下。细深绿茎和不规则叶片在鲜艳花头之间穿行，给拥挤花丛一套松散的纵向结构。白底只在破碎的空隙里露出，带有圆点飞溅、颜料滴痕、炭笔刮线和半透明淡蓝色块。颜色以透明和不透明层相叠；花瓣呈现快速的铅笔或墨线轮廓、不均匀晕染和小片干笔，而非平滑渐层。光线明亮而弥散，因此纸面本身提供最白明度，深色花心形成局部纵深。画中没有可读文字。整体构图欢腾而近乎满幅，以白色间隙、深色线性花茎和飞溅的手工肌理平衡强烈色彩碰撞。
style_prompt_en: The mixed-media painting layers transparent washes, opaque bright strokes, quick dark contours, and scattered splashes over a luminous white ground. Saturated magenta, violet, turquoise, yellow, and orange are placed as overlapping masses, while small dark centers and thin vertical lines prevent the color from becoming shapeless. Edges alternate between loose bleeding pigment and sharply scratched or inked accents. Open white pockets interrupt the dense field, providing visual rest and making the most vivid hues appear brighter. Uneven circular marks, drips, and dry-brush grain keep the surface visibly handmade. Light is even and high key, with local dark marks supplying depth rather than broad cast shadows. The overall effect is exuberant and rhythmic, balancing impulsive mark-making with a clear hierarchy of large color clusters and narrow connecting lines.
style_prompt_zh: 这种混合媒介绘画在明亮白底上叠加透明晕染、不透明的鲜亮笔触、快速深色轮廓和散开飞溅。饱和洋红、紫、青绿、黄和橙色成为相叠色团，细小深色中心与窄纵线避免颜色变成无形的一团。边缘在松散渗化的颜料与清晰刮线或墨线重音之间交替。开放的白色空隙打断密集画面，让视线休息，也使最鲜亮的颜色显得更明亮。不均匀的圆点、滴痕和干笔颗粒让表面明显出自手工。光均匀而高调，局部深色痕迹而非大范围投影提供纵深。整体效果欢腾而有节奏，在冲动的落笔与大型色团、狭窄连接线的清楚层级之间取得平衡。
theme_en: A dense bouquet of vivid watercolor flowers against a splattered white ground
theme_zh: 白色飞溅底面前一簇鲜艳的水彩花朵
name: Alisa Burke
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
